title: Open a sub-account for a member
goal: Sign on to the teller console, look up member {{member_id}}, open a new {{product}} sub-account funded with an initial deposit of {{initial_deposit}} from the member's Share Savings (suffix S01), confirm it, and read the confirmation number.

initial_deposit.description: Initial deposit transferred from Share Savings, e.g. 25.00

confirmation_number.description: Confirmation number of the opened sub-account

operator_id.description: Teller operator ID for this tenant

operator_password.description: Teller operator password for this tenant

outcomes.description: The initial deposit is below the product minimum ($5.00).
